items.exampleEn: My uncle makes his own pickles from cucumbers in his garden.
items.exampleZh: 叔叔用自己菜園種的小黃瓜做醃黃瓜。

items.exampleEn: At low tide, people dig for clams in the wet sand.
items.exampleZh: 退潮時，大家在濕沙裡挖蛤蜊。

items.exampleEn: He gulped his coffee and ran to catch the bus.
items.exampleZh: 他大口喝下咖啡，跑去趕公車。

items.exampleEn: Barley is one of the oldest crops grown by humans.
items.exampleZh: 大麥是人類最早種植的作物之一。

items.exampleEn: Bourbon gets its color from the wooden barrels it is kept in.
items.exampleZh: 波本威士忌的顏色來自存放它的木桶。

items.exampleEn: Leeks look like very large green onions.
items.exampleZh: 韭蔥看起來像非常大的青蔥。

items.exampleEn: A papaya tree grows quickly in warm weather.
items.exampleZh: 木瓜樹在溫暖的天氣裡長得很快。

items.sentenceEn: This soup is made with potatoes, leeks and a little cream.
items.sentenceZh: 這道湯是用馬鈴薯、韭蔥和一點鮮奶油做的。

items.audioEn: Don't gulp your juice so fast, or you'll get a stomachache.
items.audioZh: 果汁別喝那麼快，不然會肚子痛。

items.sentenceEn: For breakfast, she had yogurt with fresh papaya and honey.
items.sentenceZh: 她早餐吃了優格配新鮮木瓜和蜂蜜。

items.sentenceEn: This tea made from roasted barley has a warm, gentle taste.
items.sentenceZh: 這種烤大麥茶喝起來溫潤順口。

items.stemEn: The waiter served a bowl of ____ in their shells, cooked in garlic and white wine.
items.stemZh: 服務生端上一碗用大蒜和白酒煮的帶殼蛤蜊。

items.stemEn: This kind of whiskey is called ____, and much of it is made in Kentucky.
items.stemZh: 這種威士忌叫波本，大部分產自肯塔基州。

items.passageEn: My father loves trying food from different places. Last month, he took us to a seafood market by the sea. We bought fresh clams and cooked them with leeks in a big pot. My little sister gulped down a whole glass of papaya juice and asked for more. On the way home, we stopped at a farm shop that sold jars of pickles and bags of barley for soup. My father also bought a small bottle of bourbon from Kentucky as a gift for his friend. At home, we ate dinner on our new tablecloth, and everyone agreed that the meal was delicious.
items.passageZh: 我爸爸很喜歡嘗試各地的食物。上個月，他帶我們去海邊的海鮮市場。我們買了新鮮蛤蜊，和韭蔥一起放進大鍋裡煮。妹妹一口氣喝光一整杯木瓜汁，還想再喝。回家路上，我們在一家農場小店停下來，那裡賣罐裝醃黃瓜和煮湯用的大麥。爸爸還買了一小瓶肯塔基的波本威士忌，要送給朋友。回到家，我們在新桌布上吃晚餐，大家都說那頓飯很美味。

questions.questionZh: 蛤蜊是和什麼一起煮的？
爸爸買波本威士忌要做什麼？

items.promptZh: 他一口氣喝光了那杯冰水。
referenceEn: He gulped down the glass of ice water.
He gulped the cold water down in one go.
rubricZh: gulp（down）表示「大口吞下」（例如 gulp down the water 等）
時態合理即可（例如 gulped、has gulped 等）；「冰水」可寫，例如 ice water、cold water 等

items.promptZh: 這家店的漢堡裡夾了很多醃黃瓜。
referenceEn: The burgers at this shop have a lot of pickles in them.
This shop puts lots of pickles in its burgers.
rubricZh: pickle 指「醃黃瓜」，這裡用複數（例如 a lot of pickles 等）
「漢堡裡夾了」可寫，例如 have … in them、puts … in its burgers 等
時態可用現在式或過去式
